verdict.rationale: Working Copy ships a first-party conversational Repository Agent that can browse files, search content and read repositories, which covers getting natural-language insights into repositories. Nothing shows the agent working with pull requests. missing for 10: agent-driven pull request insight or creation, depth of repository analysis or insights beyond browsing and search, independent or hands-on corroboration of the agent.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can converse with an AI agent in natural language to get insights into repositories and open pull requests

citations.quote: Repository Agent is an AI assistant that you interact with through conversation. Ask it to browse files, search content, read and modify files, commit, pull and push.
Code Agent & commit suggestions. Respects your data with opt-in.
